canonical_equations: Minimize sum(w*(y-a*t0-b*t1)^2), a,b>=0; ordered RN32 Gram/RHS; enumerate origin, each nonnegative axis optimum and nonnegative interior solution; select lowest RN32 residual chi2, fixed tie order.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; flux[O,K],weights[O,K],template_pairs[P,2,K]; O/P1..128,K2..64; O*P*K<=1048576; weights/templates>=0; finite RN32 intermediates.
output_contract: O*P x[status,a,b,chi2]; status0 accepted,1 Gram determinant<=RN32(2^-18*g00*g11) then three zeros; no inferred redshift/prior, no general N-template solve.
result_contract: O*P x[status,a,b,chi2]; status0 accepted,1 Gram determinant<=RN32(2^-18*g00*g11) then three zeros; no inferred redshift/prior, no general N-template solve.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
